evals.name: multi-arch-default
evals.prompt: Gitlab CI arm64 전환해줘. 운영환경 일부 서비스는 아직 amd64 노드에서 돌고 있어 (현재 .gitlab-ci.yml은 docker buildx build 단일 amd64 잡)
evals.expected_output: Chooses multi mode; hidden .deploy-docker job extended by deploy-docker-amd64 (untagged) and deploy-docker-arm64 (tags arm64); deploy-manifest needs both and has dependencies []; plain docker build without --platform; deploy tag keeps its form; jobs that needed the old build job (update-image-tag) now need deploy-manifest; DOCKER_BUILDKIT and --secret id=...,env=... carried over verbatim; comments inside the rewritten build jobs removed while comments in untouched jobs stay.

evals.name: single-arm64
evals.prompt: arm64 단일 빌드로 전환해줘. 모든 환경을 이미 arm64 노드풀로 옮겼어 (현재 .gitlab-ci.yml은 amd64, arm64 빌드 잡과 manifest 잡으로 된 멀티아치 구성)
evals.expected_output: Runs the Before Switching rows (pod nodes, chart scheduling in the values file the deploy-tag job edits, arm64 capacity) instead of trusting the claim; any row it cannot run keeps multi and is listed as unchecked; when all pass, one deploy-docker job with tags arm64, .deploy-docker folded into it, no manifest job, and needs re-pointed to deploy-docker; Dockerfile unchanged unless it hardcodes an architecture.

evals.name: forced-single-blocker
evals.prompt: /gitlab-ci-arm64 .gitlab-ci.yml single 로 바꿔줘. prod는 아직 amd64 노드풀인데 빌드는 먼저 arm64로 돌려둘게
evals.expected_output: Takes the literal single argument without running the gate to decide mode; one deploy-docker job with tags arm64 and no manifest job; the response and MR notes state as a blocker that prod pods on amd64 fail with no match for platform in manifest until prod moves to arm64.
